appdata_skill_path.stability_note: Outer UUID has been stable for ~2 months (survived many Claude Desktop sessions). Inner UUID appears session-coupled (also appears as a peer directory under local-agent-mode-sessions/). A Claude Desktop reinstall, plugin reset, or OS migration will regenerate these.

cowork_skill_path.note: Version-controlled via OneDrive. Source of truth. Survives Claude Desktop regeneration.

cowork_desktop_skill_path.note: Cowork Desktop (Electron wrapper around claude.ai) runs skills in a cloud-hosted sandbox, not from the local AppData path. Local file edits do NOT propagate to Cowork Desktop. Skills must be re-uploaded via claude.ai UI to update Cowork Desktop's copies. This baseline does NOT cover Cowork Desktop.
